subtitle: 刘纪霆
headline:
Robot Learning & Embodied AI
Undergraduate in Mathematics
bioMarkdown:
I am an undergraduate in Mathematics at **Sichuan Agricultural University**, expecting to graduate in **2028**. My research focuses on **robot learning and embodied AI**, with an emphasis on general-purpose robot policies, spatial representation learning, and cross-embodiment generalization.

My research experience includes work in **Taku Komura’s group at The University of Hong Kong**, where I focus on cross-embodiment action retargeting for dexterous robot manipulation. I have completed the School of Computing and Data Science’s **Summer Research Internship Programme 2026**. Previously, I worked in **Bo Zhao’s group at Shanghai Jiao Tong University** from June 2025 to April 2026, studying vision-language-action models.

My work includes **Evo-Depth** (co-first author; model design and experiments) and **Evo-1** (CVPR 2026). More details are available in my [CV](/resume.pdf).
